headline: AI Overviews & Zero-Click Search: How to Rank When 83% of Searches Don't Click to Your Website
description: Your rankings held. Your traffic didn't. Here's why AI Overviews are draining clicks and what actually works in 2026.

mainEntity.name: Will AI Overviews go away eventually?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This is Google's answer to ChatGPT, and it's working for them. Every search engine is moving in this direction. Adapt, don't wait.

mainEntity.name: If I optimize for AI Overviews, will my regular Google traffic suffer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not if you do it right. Content optimised for AI Overviews also ranks better and converts better for humans - it's a win-win.

mainEntity.name: How long until I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: 30–60 days to start appearing in AI Overviews. Significant improvement takes 3–6 months of consistent effort.

mainEntity.name: Is this strategy different for different industries?

acceptedAnswer.text: The principles are the same across all industries. The specific implementation details change, but the fundamental approach works everywhere.

mainEntity.name: What if I don't have budget for a major content overhaul?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start small. Audit your top 5 traffic-generating articles. Make them 30% more comprehensive, add original insights, and improve structure.

mainEntity.name: Does this apply to e-commerce, or just B2B?

acceptedAnswer.text: It applies to everything - products, services, or solutions. If you rely on Google traffic, AI Overviews are affecting you.
